import numpy as np
y=-dP_dt
Tf={'1':np.ones_like(t),'s':np.sqrt(t),'t':t,'u':t/(1+t),'lt':np.log(t),'s*u':np.sqrt(t)*t/(1+t),'1/(1+t)':1/(1+t),'s/(1+t)':np.sqrt(t)/(1+t)}
Pf={'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3,'sqP':np.sqrt(P),'PlogP':P*np.log(P),'P2logP':P**2*np.log(P),'logP':np.log(P),'P1.5':P**1.5,'P4':P**4}
names=[];cols=[]
for a,fa in Tf.items():
    for b,fb in Pf.items():
        names.append(a+'*'+b); cols.append(fa*fb)
M=np.column_stack(cols)
c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(M,y,rcond=None)
r=M@c-y
print("full nmse",np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y))
# greedy
sel=[]
for it in range(7):
    best=None
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        if j in sel: continue
        X=M[:,sel+[j]]
        cc=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
        rr=np.sum((X@cc-y)**2)
        if best is None or rr<best[0]: best=(rr,j,cc)
    sel.append(best[1])
    print(it,[names[k] for k in sel],"nmse %.3e"%(best[0]/len(y)/np.var(y)),np.round(best[2],4))
